Subphylum Crustacea > Class Malacostraca > Order Decapoda Brachyurans Varunid crabs
Family Varunidaeupdated Dec 2019

Where seen? These crabs are seen near mangroves and freshwater streams.

Features: Small crabs that are often overlooked.

Some Varunid crabs on Singapore shores
